result:
Zed repo. Big Cargo workspace, 236 crates. ~1.3M lines Rust total.

**Structure**: not single crate — full workspace, root `Cargo.toml` list all members.

**Main pieces**:

- **gpui** — custom UI framework (own crate + `gpui_macros`, `gpui_wgpu`, `gpui_macos`/`gpui_linux`/`gpui_windows`/`gpui_web` platform backends). Zed's engine, not framework off shelf.
- **Text core** — `rope`, `text`, `multi_buffer`, `sum_tree`. Buffer data structures.
- **editor** — main text-edit component built on above.
- **language** / `lsp` / `dap` / `dap_adapters` — lang intelligence, LSP client, debug adapter protocol.
- **project** / `worktree` / `fs` — filesystem model, project state, file watching.
- **agent** / `acp_thread` / `language_model` / `language_models` / provider crates (`anthropic`, `open_ai`, `google_ai`, `ollama`, `bedrock`, etc) — AI assistant + model backends. Big chunk.
- **edit_prediction*** — Zeta / autocomplete-predict feature family.
- **collab** / `rpc` / `proto` / `client` — collab server + wire protocol.
- **git** / `git_ui` / `git_hosting_providers` — git integration.
- **terminal** / `terminal_view** — embedded terminal.
- **workspace** / `ui` / `theme` / `title_bar` — app shell, widget kit, theming.
- **vim** — vim mode.
- **extension** / `extension_host` / `extension_api` — plugin system.
- **settings** / `settings_content` / `settings_ui` — config layer.
- **zed** crate — final binary, wires all together.

Pattern: heavy crate-per-concern split, thin binary at top. GPUI = foundation everything else built on.
